hook: Cetin Duransoy is listed by Reuters Events as U.S. CEO, Revolut, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Cetin Duransoy's LinkedIn profile, the role began in January 2026, after posts as CEO of Raisin US, president and COO of Fundbox, head of credit and of installment and loyalty products at Visa, and head of small business lending at Capital One.

editor_points.desc: According to Cetin Duransoy's LinkedIn profile: CEO of Revolut US since January 2026; CEO of Raisin US from 2023 to 2026; president and COO of Fundbox from 2021 to 2023; at Visa, global head of installment and loyalty products from 2019 to 2021 and head of global credit products from 2017 to 2018; at Capital One from 2003 to 2017, including head of small business lending, a portfolio of more than $3 billion by the profile's figure, and head of business banking strategy. MBA, University of Maryland Robert H. Smith School; BSc in mechanical engineering, Middle East Technical University. The profile is Cetin Duransoy's own account and has not been checked against other records.

editor_points.desc: According to Cetin Duransoy's LinkedIn profile, the career runs through lending, credit and payments products at Capital One, Visa and Fundbox before leading Raisin US and, since January 2026, Revolut US, the role Reuters Events lists for Momentum AI Finance 2026. The profile is Cetin Duransoy's own account and has not been checked against other records.
